rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with a blastocyst image and notes thinning zona and visible blastocoel, but it hedges against the provided 3AA label by calling the embryo only fair-to-moderately good and comments on ICM/TE quality that are not clearly discernible from this single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometriosis, prior IVF/ectopic history, sperm factors, endometrium, BMI, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and structured, with the implantation estimate tied to embryo quality and adverse history; minor tension exists between accepting 3AA and visually downgrading it somewhat.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and guideline-based care, including single embryo transfer and evaluation for tubal/uterine factors after repeated failures; some suggestions are more speculative than standard first-line recommendations.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, monitoring, and future workup, including ectopic surveillance, uterine/tubal reassessment, and male-factor refinement.
